note: 'show both grid lines' is a command, but 'show' is written as the verb of an interrogative clause.
'before we circulate it wider' - 'wider' is held as a modifier of the clause of 'make' instead of the clause of 'circulate'.
'bars shorer' - 'shorer' is made the head of the nominal with 'bars' as its dependent, but 'bars' is the thing and 'shorer' says how it should be.
'to wider' - 'to' is held as a discourse word, so the tie between 'set' and 'wider' is lost.
'black with a red outline markers' - 'a red outline' is merged into the nominal of 'markers', so the relation marked 'with' ends at the wrong nominal.
'there too' is left tied to nothing, though it comments on what was asked.
'before we circulate it wider' - 'wider' is held as a modifier of the clause of 'make' instead of the clause of 'circulate'.
'at the top and on the right' - 'on the right' is written as a relation from the clause of 'show', but it belongs with 'the top' in the clause of 'set'.
